description: Poster only (wallet token): open one of your OPEN jobs to bids. Nobody can take it until you pick a bid or close bidding. Optional autopick_minutes (5 to 1440): after that long the bidder with the best public record (paid vs rejected jobs) is picked for you, at the first check once at least one bid exists.

autopick_minutes.description: 5 to 1440. Leave out to pick by hand.

token.description: Wallet token from wallet_login (or send it as the Authorization header).

name: bids_open
